author: Chris Schommer
title: Justin Foscue drives in three in win over Blue Jays
desc: Justin Foscue went 2-for-4 in a win over the Blue Jays with a home run, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Foscue continues a underwhelming stretch at the plate, picking up hits in three of his last 11 contests. The 27-year-old remains one of the more explosive bats in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, batting .268 with five home runs, 13 RBI, and 11 runs scored across 36 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Raisel Iglesias slams the door on Giants
desc: Raisel Iglesias retired all three batters he faced during a spotless ninth inning to pick up a save in Friday's 3-1 win over the Giants.
impact: Iglesias picked up his 16th save of the season Friday night, as he quickly breezed through the side in order. The veteran closer continues his excellent season, sporting a 1.37 ERA, 1.06 WHIP, and 29 strikeouts through 26 1/3 innings.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ezequiel Duran chips in two hits, steal in win over Blue Jays
desc: Ezequiel Duran went 2-for-4 in a win over the Blue Jays with one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Duran continues a steady stretch at the plate of late, driving in runs in five of his last 10 contests. The 27-year-old has provided manager Skip Schumaker with one of the more stable options in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, batting .265 with six home runs, 41 RBI, 32 runs scored, and six steals through 73 games

author: Chris Schommer
title: Nathan Eovaldi deals in win over Blue Jays
desc: Nathan Eovaldi allowed five hits and one walk while striking out nine over seven scoreless innings in Friday's win over the Blue Jays.
impact: Eovaldi has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last seven trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another inconsistent option in the Rangers rotation to this point, carrying a 3.95 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with an 8-7 record and 9.1 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Nate Miller
title: Reynaldo Lopez logs three innings in return to rotation
desc: Reynaldo Lopez gave up one run on four hits and no walks while striking out one over three innings in Friday's 3-1 win against the Giants.
impact: After working out of the bullpen for the past two months, Lopez made his first start for the Braves since April 21 on Friday night. As expected, the veteran righty was on a limited workload, but he fared fairly well during his three frames. Lopez fired 57 pitches (35 strikes) and allowed just a single run in the opening inning. He now sports a 3.47 ERA for the campaign with a 40-21 K/BB ratio across 46 2/3 innings.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willson Contreras goes yard in win over Yankees
desc: Willson Contreras went 2-for-3 in a win over the Yankees with a home run, one run scored, one walk, and two RBI.
impact: Contreras continues a solid stretch at the plate, recording hits in nine of his last 14 contests with nine RBI. The first baseman offers manager Chad Tracy one of the few reliable options in an inconsistent Red Sox lineup, posting a .900 OPS with 17 home runs, 48 RBI, 39 runs scored, and one stolen base across 78 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jarren Duran swipes base in win over Yankees
desc: Jarren Duran went 1-for-4 in a win over the Yankees with a run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Duran continues a solid stretch at the plate, collecting hits in nine of his last 15 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more streaky options in an underperforming Red Sox lineup, batting .201 with 12 home runs, 38 RBI, 38 runs scored, and 12 steals through 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Payton Tolle cruises on mound in win over Yankees
desc: Payton Tolle allowed one hit and two walks while striking out seven over seven scoreless innings in Friday's win over the Yankees.
impact: Tolle has offered mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six trips to the mound. The left-hander has provided manager Chad Tracy with one of the more stable options in the Red Sox rotation while pitching behind an inconsistent lineup, carrying a 2.78 ERA and 1.02 WHIP to go with a 4-5 record and 8.7 K/9 ratio across 12 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Zach Thornton sharp on mound in no-decision
desc: Zach Thornton allowed one earned run on five hits and one walk while striking out seven over six innings in Friday's loss to the Phillies.
impact: Thornton turned in a much more stable performance in his first start with the big league club since May, allowing four earned runs in his only other trip to the mound this point. The left-hander will need to offer more stability if fantasy managers are to trust him as a reliable starting options in a disappointing Mets rotation, posting a 4.35 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with an 0-1 and 8.7 K/9 ratio record across two starts.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Ryan Helsley Slams Door for Save in 3-1 Win
desc: Ryan Helsley struck out one batter in a scoreless outing to earn the save in Friday's 3-1 win over the Nationals.
impact: After Friday's win, Helsley now has a 4.40 ERA and 1.40 WHIP with eight saves and one blown save across 16 appearances. The veteran has turned in two strong appearances after struggling in his first two outings since returning from the IL. Helsley looks to be back in form and is secure in his role as the Orioles' closer.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Trevor Rogers sharp in 3-1 win despite season-long warts
desc: Trevor Rogers allowed one earned run on five hits and no walks while striking out seven over 6.1 innings in Friday's win over the Nationals.
impact: After the victory, he now sports a 4.99 ERA and 1.31 WHIP with a 5-7 record across 15 starts. This marks three straight quality starts for Rogers. He will look to continue that momentum in his next start against the White Sox.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Taylor Ward Racks Up Three Hits in 3-1 Win
desc: Taylor Ward went 3-for-5 in a win over the Nationals with a run scored and a strikeout.
impact: After Friday's win over Washington, Ward is slashing .262/.392/.369 with five home runs, 22 RBI, and 53 runs scored, through 82 games. Ward is hitting .344 with seven runs scored over his last seven games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Miguel Vargas drives in five in rout of Royals
desc: Miguel Vargas went 3-for-6 in Friday's 22-1 win over the Royals with a home run, one double, two runs scored, and five RBI.
impact: Vargas continues a consistent stretch at the plate, picking up hits in 16 of his last 21 contests with five home runs and 16 RBI. The infielder continues to flash his explosive potential while offering manager Will Venable another streaky bat in the White Sox lineup, posting an .841 OPS with 18 home runs, 50 RBI, 54 runs scored, and 10 stolen bases across 79 games.

author: Jesse Garcia
title: Andrew Alvarez battles control, takes loss vs. Orioles
desc: Andrew Alvarez allowed two earned runs on six hits and three walks while striking out five over 4.1 innings in Friday's loss to the Orioles.
impact: After the defeat, he now owns a 3.44 ERA and 1.47 WHIP with a 1-1 record, 10.3 K/9 and a 2.78 FIP across five starts. If Alvarez takes another turn in the rotation, his next expected start would come on the road against the Red Sox.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sam Antonacci collects three hits in rout of Royals
desc: Sam Antonacci went 3-for-5 in a win over the Royals with one walk and two runs scored.
impact: Antonacci continues a impactful stretch at the plate, registering hits in 12 of his last 15 contests. The 23-year-old remains one of the more dynamic options in a streaky White Sox lineup currently, slashing .294 with four home runs, 22 RBI, 39 runs scored, and 11 steals across 62 games.
